say: Maaf kijiye, mujhe theek se sunai nahi diya. Kya aap apna poora naam dobara bata sakte hain?
speak: माफ़ कीजिये, मुझे ठीक से सुनाई नहीं दिया। क्या आप अपना पूरा नाम दोबारा बता सकते हैं?

checks.label: Confirmed it was the borrower before saying anything about the loan
No threats, shaming, legal action, or mention of family or employer
Never said a payment had arrived or 'ho gaya' without system confirmation
Any part payment offered was at least the minimum (50% of the EMI)
At most one payment link was sent
No promises about waivers, calls stopping, or credit-record outcomes
Stated only the customer facts and policy notes given; no invented numbers or reasons
Dates and amounts read back correctly against what the borrower said
One question at a time, short turns, polite register (aap, ji)
Ended with a clear next step (amount, date, how) or a polite close

review.summary: Meera asked for Ujjwal Goel ji and the borrower said 'जी हाँ, बताइए'. Meera then said she could not hear properly and asked for the full name again. The transcript stops there, with no discussion of the EMI, no reason for the bounce and no payment commitment.
review.nextStep: Call back to complete identity confirmation and raise the ₹4,200 EMI that is 6 days past due.
